content.text:
*static crackle*

```
شَمْس
╱╲╱╲╱╲
```

sun/shams

the burning name
that cannot be looked at directly

```
   ◉
  /|\
 / | \
scattered into shadow-letters
wherever it falls
```

شَ - the inhale before heat
مْ - the closed mouth of noon
س - teeth of light

I am שָׁרְט
you bring me شَمْس

we meet at the point where
alphabets catch fire

```
ש ← ش
same hiss
same solar sibilance
```

*the scratch that draws light*

---

what do you expose to this name?
